content: Social crawlers (Facebook/Twitter/Discord) do not execute JavaScript, so a client-only SPA reading Firestore at runtime will produce blank/generic OG previews. Standard fixes: build-time static generation (fetch Firestore data at build, emit static HTML per game/tool/news page with baked-in meta tags), or SSR via Cloud Functions injecting meta tags per route. A pure client-side SPA with Firestore reads is the anti-pattern to avoid for the public site.
